fields.label: Insurance
fields.description: LAA: one row per business unit. LAAC / IJM: one row per insurance code (and per wage bracket).

fields.label: Code
fields.description: LAA: the business unit letter (A-Z) — the scope digit is set per employee. LAAC / IJM: the two-character code (person group + category), as communicated by the insurer.

fields.label: Wage From (per year)
fields.description: Lower bound of the insured salary, per year, as the insurer publishes it.

fields.label: Wage To (per year)
fields.description: Upper bound per year. Leave empty for no upper bound. LAA is always capped at the legal ceiling.

fields.label: Employee Rate (%)
fields.description: LAA: the non-occupational premium (NBUV/AANP) of the unit. LAAC / IJM: employee share, men (or everyone if the insurer does not differentiate).

fields.label: Employer Rate (%)
fields.description: LAA: the occupational premium (BUV/AAP) of the unit, always the employer's. LAAC / IJM: employer share, men (or everyone).

fields.label: Employee Rate, Women (%)
fields.description: Only when the insurer charges women differently. Empty = same as above.

fields.label: Employer Rate, Women (%)
fields.description: Only when the insurer charges women differently. Empty = same as above.
